verdict.rationale: OpenAI ships an official `whisper` command-line tool, installed via `pip install -U openai-whisper`, with documented flags for model, language and translate tasks. The official OpenAI CLI also exposes transcription directly (`openai audio:transcriptions create --model gpt-transcribe --file ...`). Missing for 10: documentation of agent-friendly CLI behavior such as machine-readable output formats or scripting/exit-code guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of the official CLI (the community reports concern whisper.cpp and third-party tools).
